repaired.name: Scenario

diagnosis.summary: The IR requires a 1-minute (60,000 ms) sustained wait before acting. The candidate uses a 1000 ms period and a threshold of 60 ticks, which corresponds to only 60 seconds. The mismatch at 59000 ms (F2) shows the JoI acted too early because the threshold was calculated as D/period instead of D/period + 1. The correct threshold for 60000 ms on a 1000 ms grid is 601.
diagnosis.change_summary: Changed the threshold from 60 to 601. With a 1000 ms period, the first tick counts at t=0. To sustain for 60000 ms, the counter must reach 601 (covering ticks 0 through 600). The original 60 allowed the action to fire at t=59000 ms, violating the 1-minute requirement.
